# Requests by Colart

> A dedicated hub built by Colart Digital Marketing Agency for karaoke bars and entertainment venues to collect live song requests — sent straight to the venue over WhatsApp — alongside digital menus, promos and guest-experience tools.

Requests by Colart (requests.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com) lists Colart's karaoke and entertainment venue partners. Each venue gets its own branded page where guests fill in a request table (song name, artist name, transpose, client name, venue/table info) that is compiled into a message and opened directly in WhatsApp to the venue.

## Venues

- [Tune Karaoke](https://requests.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/tunekaraoke): Mobile karaoke experience bringing music, fun and entertainment to pubs, cafés, private parties, birthdays and events. Requests are sent via WhatsApp to +961 71 663 923. Follow on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok as @tune.karaoke.lb.
- [Joe's Bar — Batroun](https://requests.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/joesbarbatroun): Batroun's karaoke bar for over 20 years. Guests pick one of three hosts (Joe, MJ, or J.P.) and their request is sent to that host directly on WhatsApp.
